name: seated-barbell-front-raise.html
instructions:
1. Select the desired weight and load it onto a barbell. Grasp the bar with a pronated grip with your hands around shoulder width apart.
2. Sit down on the end of a flat bench and let the barbell rest on your thighs.
3. Take the weight off your thighs and hold the barbell slightly above your thighs. This is the starting position for the exercise.
4. Inhale, brace your core, and raise your arms vertically while keeping the elbows nearly locked out.
5. Once the arms are parallel with the floor, slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
